title: Quotient of a connected Galois cover by a subgroup
statement: Let $U$ be a nonempty connected scheme [def-weil-connected-scheme], let $G$ be a finite group, and let $c:E\to U$ be a finite etale morphism with $E$ connected which is a Galois cover with group $G$ [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]: $G$ acts on $E$ over $U$, $E/G\cong U$, and $G$ acts simply transitively on every geometric fibre of $c$. Let $H\le G$ be a subgroup, acting on $E$ by restriction. Let $\pi:E\to Z$ be a morphism of $U$-schemes which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], satisfies $\mathcal O_Z=(\pi_*\mathcal O_E)^H$, and is a categorical quotient of $E$ by $H$ in schemes: every $H$-invariant morphism from $E$ to a scheme factors uniquely through $\pi$. Then $\pi$ is surjective, the structure morphism $v:Z\to U$ is finite etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], $Z$ is connected, and every geometric fibre of $v$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-fibre] has exactly $[G:H]$ points. The cases $H=1$ and $H=G$ are included.

source.place: Lemma 03BK (groupoids-lemma-invariants-base-change), part (3): formation of invariants of a finite group commutes with flat base change, applied after an etale base change trivializing the torsor (E becomes G x U', its H-quotient (G/H) x U'). Used in ILO XVI 3.7, p.255, for the generic degree [G:H] of X''/H over X.

from.place: Proof Step 3: dimension-normalized Verdier duality, regular finite-torsion local model; pointwise purity and composition used to compare the normalized curve with the ambient regular scheme. Input: Gabber purity for a regular Noetherian closed pair. More precisely: Expose XVI, section 3.7 second paragraph through its last paragraph, printed pp.254--255: semistable G-alteration, ell-Sylow H, tame equivariant modification, quotient over T=S prime/H, and log resolution. Geometric construction only, before applying Theorem 3.6.2 and Proposition 3.5.7; preliminary finite extension to normalize constants in the first paragraph. Specifically: XVI 3.7, p.255: 'Le morphisme evident X''' -> X est ... generiquement un revetement etale de degre premier a ell', for the quotient X''/H of the restricted Sylow action.
